
# My first 2D fluid simulation: Incompressible fluid wit constant and uniform density

This will be the first set of circumstances I model as it seems to be the simplest possible situation. Even with these constraints there are some different situations we can focus on to start:

- Water being pushed through a box in a uniform manner: the entire vector field is linear with no vorticity and no friction with the walls.
- Water being pushed through a box non-uniformly: ie viscosity (internal drag) needs to be taken into account.
- Same thing but this time with friction on walls.
- Thermal affecting boyency: but by faking change of volume: boyency not change in density.
